conbody.p: The Git Client add-on contributes dedicated Git views, a top-level Git menu, a preferences page, and Git actions in contextual menus. Review this section first to learn where Git actions are available and which part of the interface to use for each Git workflow.

The main interface components are the Git Staging view for daily review, stage, commit, push, and pull operations, the Git History view for inspecting commits and affected resources, and the Git Branch Manager view for working with local and remote branches. The Git menu and contextual actions provide extra entry points for repository-level and resource-level actions.

The add-on also contributes a Git Client preferences page where you can configure how the Git Client detects working copies, validates files before commit or push operations, uses SSH agents, and stores global or project-level settings.
